title: ArchitectureRoadmap
description: TOGAF-sourced archetype — a definition of sequenced architecture transitions from baseline to target state. A governance definition of planned change. Rootless, domain-scoped. TOGAF mapping: Architecture Roadmap (ADM Phase E, Opportunities and Solutions). Source framework: TOGAF (ADM, Phase E).

horizonType.description: Planning horizon. SHORT_TERM = 0-6 months. MEDIUM_TERM = 6-18 months. LONG_TERM = 18+ months. TOGAF mapping: Architecture Roadmap planning horizon.

transitionCount.description: Number of planned transition architectures. TOGAF mapping: Architecture Roadmap transition sequence count.

baselineState.description: Reference to or description of the baseline architecture state. TOGAF mapping: Architecture Roadmap baseline.

targetState.description: Reference to or description of the target architecture state. TOGAF mapping: Architecture Roadmap target.
